'''Rainbow Parkway''' was a street on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was at the corner of Rainbow Parkway and [[Gallery Row]] that a [[Duel at Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row|duel]] was fought in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].
